operation.document:
query GetInitiativeComments($id: String!, $filterId: ID!, $after: String) { initiative(id: $id) { id name } comments(first: 50, after: $after, orderBy: createdAt, filter: { initiative: { id: { eq: $filterId } } }) { nodes { ...CommentListFields } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
fragment CommentListFields on Comment { id body quotedText createdAt updatedAt editedAt url user { id name displayName } externalUser { id name displayName } botActor { id name type subType } parent { id } }
